items.title: Approval of City Attorney Invoices for the Month of June 2025
items.recommendation: Approve invoices in the amount of $129,921.94

items.title: Approve a First Amendment to the Professional Services Agreement with Clinical Laboratory Services of San Bernardino, Inc.
items.recommendation: Staff recommends amending the existing PSA to reflect the accurate annual service cost of $88,265, resulting in a total not-to-exceed amount of $264,795.00 over the three-year period. This amendment ensures the agreement aligns with the scope of services and pricing detailed in the vendor's proposal.

items.title: Notice of Completion for Public Works Agreement C25-05: 514-516 California Avenue
items.recommendation: Authorize the Mayor to execute a Notice of Completion for C25-05: 514-516 California Ave Interior and Exterior Paint; and Authorize the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion with the County Recorder’s Office.

items.title: Quarterly Report of City Manager Purchases and Contract Awards
items.recommendation: Receive and file.

items.title: Follow-Up Report No. 7 Local State of Emergency Sewer Mainline Failure Emergency Repairs in Fairway Canyon
items.recommendation: Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution Of The City Council of The City Of Beaumont Extending The Declaration of A Local Emergency and Authorizing The City Manager To Take Necessary Action”, and Direct staff to return at the next Council meeting regarding the status and requirements of applicable environmental permits.

items.title: Notice of Completion for Capital Improvement Project P-20: Playgrounds with Shade Phase 3
items.recommendation: Authorize the Mayor to execute a Notice of Completion for CIP P-20 Playgrounds with Shade Phase 3; and Authorize the City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion with the County Recorder’s Office.

items.title: Acceptance of the City of Beaumont 2024 Single Audit Report on Federal Awards
items.recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Single Audit for the Fiscal Year ended June 30, 2024.

items.title: Second Reading of an Ordinance and Development Agreement by and between the City of Beaumont and Beaumont Regency AVG LLC (PLAN2025-0177)
items.recommendation: Waive the second full reading and adopt by title only, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Approving a Development Agreement by and between the City of Beaumont and Beaumont Regency AVG LLC.”

items.title: Fiscal Year 2025-2026 Budget Book and Budget-in-Brief
items.recommendation: Receive and file the FY2025-2026 Budget Book and Budget-in-Brief.

items.title: Approval of Purchase Order Increase for Spicer Consulting Group, Inc. for Special District Administration Services
items.recommendation: Approve a change order to Purchase Order No. 24/251912 with Spicer Consulting Group, LLC for CFD Administration Services, increasing the not-to-exceed amount by $16,090.28, for a revised total amount not to exceed $199,692.29.

items.title: Quarterly Grants Report FY2024-2025 Q4
items.recommendation: Receive and file report.

items.title: Quitclaim of Easement from Southern California Edison on City-Owned Property
items.recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council Accept the Partial Quitclaim of Easement from Southern California Edison on APN 404-140-007 and authorize the Mayor to execute the Certificate of Acceptance and direct staff to record the Quitclaim and Certificate with the Riverside County Recorder’s Office.

items.title: Public Hearing - Placement of Delinquent Solid Waste Handling Services Charges on the Riverside County Auditor Property Tax Rolls
items.recommendation: Conduct a public hearing, and Waive the full reading and approve by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Authorizing the Collection of Delinquent Solid Waste Handling Service Charges on the Property Tax Roll.”

items.title: Public Hearing to Consider the Placement of Delinquent Sewer Service Fees and Charges on the Property Tax Roll
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing, and Waive the full reading and adopt by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Authorizing the Collection of Delinquent Sewer Service Fees and Charges on the Property Tax Roll.”

items.title: Public Hearing to Adopt a Mitigated Negative Declaration for the Cherry Channel Drainage Project – Capital Improvement Project No. R-07 in compliance with the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing; and Adopt a Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation and Monitoring Reporting Program for the Cherry Channel Drainage (Project); and Direct staff to prepare a Notice of Determination to be filed with the Riverside County Clerk Recorder.

items.title: Public Hearing - Introduction of Ordinance and Resolution to add Parking Citation Penalties/Fines to the Citywide Fee Schedule
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing; Waive the first full reading and approve by title only: “An Ordinance Of The City Council Of The City Of Beaumont, California, Amending Chapter 10.08 - Parking By Adding Section 10.08.101 – Parking And Late Payment Penalties Schedule To The Beaumont Municipal Code” And; Adopt the Resolution and approve by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City Of Beaumont, California, Adopting A New Parking Violation And Late Payment Penalty Schedule.”

items.title: Authorize Employment Contract with Chief of Police
items.recommendation: Approve the employment agreement with Christopher Ramos for Chief of Police and authorize the City Manager to sign the agreement; and Conduct Swearing In.

items.title: Discussion and Direction on a Proposed Recycled Water Reuse Strategy
items.recommendation: Direct staff to pursue a hybrid recycled water strategy, work with the San Gorgonio Pass Water Agency on a financial partnership for a siting study, and develop a tiered pricing structure with BCVWD for the sale of recycled water as part of the ongoing negotiation matrix.

items.title: Approval of Agreement with Stradling Yocca Carlson & Rauth for Bond Counsel Services
items.recommendation: Approve engagement with Stradling Yocca Carlson & Rauth for as-needed bond counsel services for the period of July 15, 2025, to June 30, 2030, with compensation based on actual services rendered in accordance with the terms and rates established in the agreement; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any related documents.

items.title: Approval of Agreement with Urban Futures, Inc. (UFI) for Financial Advisory Services
items.recommendation: Approve a professional services agreement with Urban Futures, Inc. (UFI) for as-needed financial advisory services for the period of July 15, 2025, through July 15, 2030, with compensation based on actual services rendered in accordance with the terms and rates established in the agreement; and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any related documents.

items.title: Award Two Maintenance Services Agreements to: (1) Integrity Arborist & Ecoscape and (2) Sustainable Mitigation for Annual Weed Abatement Services
items.recommendation: Approve the Agreement with Integrity Arborist & Ecoscape for Weed Abatement Services, for an initial contract period of July 15, 2025, through June 30, 2028, in an annual amount of $173,750 with a total three-year amount not to exceed $521,250; and Approve the Agreement with Sustainable Mitigation for Weed Abatement Services, for an initial contract period of July 15, 2025, through June 30, 2028, in an annual amount of $173,750 with a total three-year amount not to exceed $521,250.

items.title: Pennsylvania Avenue Grade Separation Update – Capital Improvement Project No. 2017-012
items.recommendation: Receive and file this update.

items.title: Discussion Item: Authorization for City Engineer to Designate Curb Colors Following Traffic Survey Evaluation, including Community Mailboxes
items.recommendation: Direct staff to prepare a draft ordinance authorizing the City Engineer to evaluate and designate curb colors following traffic surveys and return to the City Council for formal consideration and public hearing at a future meeting.

items.title: Purple Heart License Plate Holders Designated Parking Spaces
items.recommendation: Staff recommends a directive to propose an amendment to the Beaumont parking standards to include a requirement for Purple Heart recipient parking spaces.
